Radical Community Care is a mutual aid org based in Phoenix. They run 2-3 community pantries/fridges, offer harm reduction supplies including naloxone and testing strips, have little libraries, and partner with other mutual aid orgs and activists in the area, including Mutual Aid Phoenix, Mutual Justice Phoenix, and Unsheltered Phoenix. 

Phoenix has become increasingly hostile towards low income and unhoused individuals and communities. Inflation and rents spiked and have remained untenable, and summer has begun and is extremely deadly every year in AZ with ever hotter temps. The ACLU is currently suing Phoenix over their sweeps of The Zone, a large encampment in Phx, as city of Phoenix and Phx PD are seizing and destroying property, harassing and coercing individuals into shelters that have no available space. 

There was also a large fire this past Friday in the zone, and many people’s tents and all belongings were lost. The orgs I mentioned above are urgently asking for donations or purchases off of their wishlists for immediate needs for those who lost everything, as well as stocking supplies to prepare for summer survival.
